g.text: Frozen band ratio: 8.65 · Allowing a jump improves the illustrative fit’s χ² by only 0.065*

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #21384a

g.text: The blue band is faint. The box extraction allows zero blue light within its uncertainty, so its ratio has no finite upper 95% bound.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #556a79

g.text: A: archive-rescaled 1σ errors; frozen bands and means shaded / colored. Dotted purple: hydrogen’s limit, 3646 Å.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #556a79

g.text: *The continuous model may bend at 3646 Å; it is an illustrative assumption, not a physical identification or proof that no edge exists.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #556a79

g.text: B: bars are supplied diagonal 1σ errors for each estimator. All points reuse the same exposures; their spread is not a confidence interval.
